findings.headline_summary:
RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Operating Framework
Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Operating Framework: The policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) serves as the anchor rate for money market interest rates. The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate operates at repo rate minus 25 bps (6.25% when repo is 6.50%), and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) operates at repo rate plus 25 bps (6.75%). The MPC targets medium-term consumer price index (CPI) headline inflation of 4.0% within a +/- 2.0% tolerance band.

findings.summary:
SEBI LODR Regulation 30: Disclosure of Material Events
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 30: Every listed entity shall promptly make disclosures of any events or information which, in the opinion of the board of directors, are material. Material events under Schedule III Part A must be disclosed to recognized stock exchanges (NSE/BSE) as soon as reasonably possible and no later than: (a) thirty minutes from the closure of the board meeting for outcome disclosures; (b) twelve hours from occurrence for events originating within the entity; (c) twenty-four hours from occurrence for external events.

findings.llm_adversarial_analysis: Adversarial critique evaluated against deterministic risk and stress parameters.

stress_tests.circuit_filter_boundary: PASS: Maximum single-day price move of 16.75% strictly within NSE 20.0% circuit boundary.
stress_tests.volatility_shock_test: FAIL: Baseline annualized volatility (69.9%) exceeds 80% boundary; 2x shocked VaR (20.5%) exceeds 15.0% single-stock stress limit.
stress_tests.statutory_drag_test: FAIL: Sample annualized return (-76.63%) fails to cover statutory drag of 11.86 bps.
stress_tests.liquidity_contraction_test: PASS: Under 50% turnover drop (INR 196.20 Cr), estimated market impact 8.9 bps remains <= 25.0 bps threshold.
stress_tests.lookahead_leakage_audit: PASS: Point-in-time timestamp matching verified across 125 bars with zero future leakage.

circuit_filter_boundary.expected_condition: Maximum trailing single-day absolute price move <= 20.0% (NSE statutory circuit filter)
circuit_filter_boundary.explanation: PASS: Maximum single-day price move of 16.75% strictly within NSE 20.0% circuit boundary.
circuit_filter_boundary.limitations: Corporate actions or split unadjusted bars trigger false circuit breaches.

volatility_shock_test.expected_condition: Annualized realized volatility <= 80.0% and 2x shocked 99% parametric daily VaR <= 15.0%
volatility_shock_test.explanation: FAIL: Baseline annualized volatility (69.9%) exceeds 80% boundary; 2x shocked VaR (20.5%) exceeds 15.0% single-stock stress limit.
volatility_shock_test.limitations: Assumes log-normal return distribution; tail heaviness under shock may underestimate kurtosis.

statutory_drag_test.expected_condition: Sample annualized return strictly covers Finance Act 2024 statutory friction drag (11.86 bps)
statutory_drag_test.explanation: FAIL: Sample annualized return (-76.63%) fails to cover statutory drag of 11.86 bps.
statutory_drag_test.limitations: Historical sample mean return does not guarantee forward alpha realization.

liquidity_contraction_test.expected_condition: Turnover under 50% contraction >= 25.0 Cr and stressed market impact <= 25.0 bps
liquidity_contraction_test.explanation: PASS: Under 50% turnover drop (INR 196.20 Cr), estimated market impact 8.9 bps remains <= 25.0 bps threshold.
liquidity_contraction_test.limitations: Parametric Kyle's lambda proxy; order book queue depth omitted to prevent numerical fabrication.

lookahead_leakage_audit.expected_condition: All bar timestamps strictly <= decision cutoff timestamp (zero lookahead leakage)
lookahead_leakage_audit.explanation: PASS: Point-in-time timestamp matching verified across 125 bars with zero future leakage.
lookahead_leakage_audit.limitations: Relies on database partition metadata accuracy and DuckDB analytical query bounds.
